biggest_catch: Your friend has to make 10 qualifying transactions within 60 days of joining (debits, deposits, Bill Pay all count), or nobody gets the bonus.
catches: The referred candidate must become a new Teachers member, open a checking account, and perform 10 qualifying transactions within 60 calendar days of establishing membership (debit card purchases, direct deposits, mobile deposits, in-branch deposits, ATM deposits, Teachers Bill Pay).
You can receive up to 10 referrals totaling $500 per calendar year.
Both the member and referred accounts must not be closed or restricted at the time of payout.
Business accounts are not eligible; employees of Teachers FCU and its affiliates are not eligible.
Referral link is shared from the referrer's online or mobile banking account (Additional Services).
Bonuses may be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.

steps: Log into Teachers online or mobile banking and get your referral link under Additional Services.
Share the referral link with a friend or family member via email, text message, Facebook, or Messenger.
Your friend becomes a new Teachers member and opens a checking account.
Within 60 calendar days of establishing membership, the friend performs 10 qualifying transactions (debit purchases, direct deposits, mobile/in-branch/ATM deposits, Teachers Bill Pay).
You and your friend each receive a $50 bonus deposited into your primary Regular Savings accounts within 4 weeks - up to $500 in referral bonuses per calendar year.
timing: Once all conditions are met by the referred new member, Teachers deposits the $50 bonus into both parties' primary Regular Savings accounts within 4 weeks.
